csp.title: Content-Security-Policy
csp.description: A CSP tells browsers which servers may run scripts and load content on your site, so an injected script from elsewhere is blocked. GetSafe 360 builds a policy from what your pages load and tests it first without blocking anything.
csp.scanned: {count, plural, one {Built from # page.} other {Built from # pages.}} Proposed policy:
csp.inlineNote: Your theme or plugins use inline scripts, so the policy allows them. It still limits which servers may run code, blocks plugins and base-tag tricks, and stops other sites from framing yours.
csp.reportOnlyNote: Testing runs in report-only mode: visitors' browsers report what the policy would block, but nothing is blocked. You can stop it any time under Applied changes.
csp.testingSince: Testing since {date} ({days, plural, =0 {today} one {# day} other {# days}}).
csp.reports: {count, plural, =0 {No reports yet} one {# report} other {# reports}}
csp.noReports: No browser has reported a problem yet. Let the test run for a few days of normal traffic.
csp.testingHint: Each line is something the policy would have blocked. After a few days, Claude will help you decide what to allow before you switch the policy on. To stop the test, undo it under Applied changes.
